name: Marjorie Wheeler (Schlatter)
milestones: Matron of honor at her sister Dorothy Ann’s wedding to George Homer Allen, 8 May 1944, Sioux Falls, SD
sources: Newspaper clippings and obituaries in Bill Allen’s family document (2011)
Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Sister of Dorothy Ann Wheeler; matron of honor at her wedding [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 6337]

CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Parents set to Melvin Wheeler and Dorothy Douthit Pfander, and husband Charles W. Schlatter, from the 1944 wedding notice ("Sister Is Attendant: Mrs. Charles W. Schlatter (Marjorie Wheeler)") and Dorothy Ann’s register entry in Bill Allen’s document.
Unclear reference: Probably the "Marge" in the photo caption "Dorothy A, Dorothy D & Marge". [Bill Allen, line 6249]
